Protocol.Description: System Monitor of the Local computer

Hint.P1: SystemMonitor: Map to a SystemMonitor template tag Processor: Used CPU Percentage MemoryAvailable: Total of memory available (including virtual memory) in kilobytes MemoryInUse: Total of memory being used (including virtual memory) in kilobytes MemoryTotal: Total of memory (including virtual memory) in kilobytes MemoryPhysicalAvailable: Total of physical memory available in kilobytes MemoryPhysicalInUse: Total of physical memory being used in kilobytes MemoryPhysicalTotal: Total of physical memory in kilobytes HDWriteBytesPerSecond: Bytes per seconds written to the Hard Disk HDReadBytesPerSecond: Bytes per seconds read from the Hard Disk NetDataReceivedBytesPerSecond: Bytes per seconds received through the network NetDataSentBytesPerSecond: Bytes per seconds sent through the network
